body:
Well, I went ahead and tried implementing the "super obvious" implementation of this module (i.e., just calling `dotnet --version` if we see `.sln`, `.csproj`, `.fsproj`, or `.xproj` in the directory.

Sadly `dotnet --version` is quite slow, and it made starship noticeably slow. I don't think that solution is tenable.

So this feature is going to require some more thought.

I suspect we can go much faster by manually parsing `project.json` and `global.json` for pinned versions. When they aren't present, we could fall back to `dotnet --list-sdks`, which is an order of magnitude faster than `--version`, and pick the last item on that list.

The downsides to that approach are:
- Questions around correctness of our version logic
- Having to update the modules as the rules change in the dotnet ecosystem
